title: ADR-0150 addendum: knowledge_source joins bucket 3 — one slot per (package, name), the AI face spells NS-NAME
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbW5anP6GDaVi5LKi2U

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #37000; maintainer ruling on #37304 Q1 = B (comment 7168239918, 「按应用+名字区分，都保留」, decision thread 2026-11-25). Step 1 of #37304's ruled execution, split out because an implementation card's file surface does not carry `docs/adr/**`.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 (topic) · reach: every package that ships a knowledge source · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：在 ADR-0150 上加一条带日期的补充说明：知识源和技能、资料包一样，按「应用包 + 名字」区分，两个应用包带同名知识源时都保留，AI 要写「应用-名字」来指明，这是您刚裁的 B。
- 为什么先做：ADR-0150 规定哪些类型按应用包分槽，新加一个类型要先写进记录，#37304 的代码按它来。
- 需要你做的：合并这个 PR（ADR 属受治理面）。

## What
1. A dated addendum to ADR-0150 admitting `knowledge_source` to bucket 3 beside `skill` and `ai_context`, in the PR #37209 precedent's form: one slot per `(package, name)`; the AI face spells `NS-NAME` and refuses a bare ambiguous name loudly (409); document ids and adapter tables are keyed by package too.
2. Name what follows: #37304 takes the four lists and readers and the store keying (memory, pgvector, turso); #37100 / #37107 inherit the keying if they land first.

## Acceptance
- The addendum quotes the ruling comment id and the maintainer's words; earlier text of the record unchanged.
- Docs-only PR (`docs/adr/**`), Tier H: the maintainer merges.

Parent: #37000. Reader: the `domain:skills` lane via this project's card thread (`repo:cloud#1`). Blocks #37304.
Dedupe: `ADR-0150 knowledge_source` 1 (#37304); `bucket 3 addendum` 0 open.
